content.rendered:
We hope to be able to offer a picture day in late spring. We will communicate the dates with you as soon as we are able to reschedule with Dorian Studios. Thanks for your patience and understanding.

Picture day is coming to Middleton. We are excited to have our friends at Dorian photograph our students. They will be following all safety precautions to keep everyone safe during this process. Save the date and mark your calendar. We are offering two dates, January 12th and the 14th with evening appointments available too. Please stay tuned for more information to follow with the availability to schedule your photo time.

You will have the ability to pre-order pictures by visiting Dorian Studio and searching for our school name. Your on-line order can be placed now and up to four days after picture day.

If you need further assistance please call Dorian Studios at (800) 826-3535 or you can try us here at Middleton too. 503-825-5300
